constraints: The picked color is applied to the current text selection in the object with focus only if that object's 'Allow Font/Color Picker' property is checked; otherwise the command has no visible effect.
This dialog box is modal under Windows but not under macOS.
If the color was changed, the On After Edit form event is generated for the object.

sentinelValues.meaning: Apply the selected color to the text (also the default if omitted).
Apply the selected color to the text background.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Displays the system color picker dialog box and applies the selected color to either the text or the text background of the focused object's current selection, according to textOrBackground.
overloadMerges.note: Documented the textOrBackground 0/1 sentinel values, which autoparse left as a bare optional Integer.
